## Description

Couples neural Hawkes point processes with jump-diffusion stochastic differential equations to model self-exciting order bursts and sudden price jumps across interconnected order books.

## Where it may fit

Flash crashes, macroeconomic news release shocks, high-frequency order book toxicity detection.

## Vehicles

High-frequency market makers, statistical arbitrage desks, algorithmic execution platforms.

## Required data

Tick-level trade timestamps, quote updates, order cancellation event streams.

## Caveats

Maximum likelihood estimation of neural Hawkes kernels requires high-performance C++/GPU acceleration.
